newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister not to pursue civil service cut.
newsitem.headline: French minister not to pursue civil service cut.

text.p: minister Emile Zuccarelli has told unions he will not pursue the previous centre-right government's policy of cutting civil service staff posts, Les Echos newspaper said on Wednesday.
It said the pledge in principle was made during talks with unions on Tuesday.
But it was not clear what would happen to the previous government's 1997 budget plan to trim civil service posts by more than 5,000, mainly in the national education system.
Unions are already seeking the reopening of wage talks after previous civil service minister Dominique Perben imposed a pay rise earlier this year of a total 2.8 percent spread of 1997 and 1998.
Unions want a "catch-up" payment to compensate for a pay freeze in 1996.
